verdict.rationale: Auth0 stores user identity data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair axis to ask about. The pack, however, documents only adjacent capabilities: bulk user import/export, data-residency region choice, log streaming to external services, and generic 'manage users' via the MCP server or CLI. None of these is a documented retention-period setting or data-deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
